evidence.exact_span: Asciano also raises a policy argument that the result (that whether a purchase for a particular use is credit-eligible turns on whether the use occurs on or off-rail) is anomalous.

INTRODUCTION
1 This is a classic statutory interpretation case.

To the extent there is any doubt as to whether off-rail activities are covered, that doubt must be judicially resolved in the Commissioner's favour because on any view it cannot be said that off-rail activities are explicitly included by ss 38 and 53 of the Act .
